rows.text: Spectrum Talent Management Limited has informed the Exchange about Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company- Show Cause Notice received from GST Authority

receives a **GST show-cause notice demanding Rs 10,08,10,284** for IGST of Rs 5.04 crore and an equal penalty from the Additional Commissioner, Noida, under Section 74; it will reply and pursue remedies.
